metadata.title: Crash with SIGFPE due to unhandled cases in distributions.MultivariateNormal

trigger_conditions.condition: Providing distribution parameters with incompatible scalar, batch, or event dimensions, such as a 0-dimensional loc tensor with a matrix covariance input.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Passing a 0-dimensional scalar tensor as loc to torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal with a 1x1 covariance matrix (e.g., torch.eye(1) * sigma).

failure_behavior.description: Passing a 0-dimensional scalar tensor as loc to torch.distributions.MultivariateNormal with a 1x1 covariance matrix (e.g., torch.eye(1) * sigma).
